entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so confused by the whole process on your website.
I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference issue?
Oh, it works fine, I think. It's just... not for me. I tried to return it last week, but the website was acting so strange. I think it was a website error or something.
I'm sorry to hear you had trouble with the site. Can you tell me a bit more about what happened?

I filled out the form, but when I hit submit, the page just went blank. I couldn't print the shipping label or anything. I even took a screenshot because I didn't know what to do. The whole system seemed to be down. Can't you just help me? I don't understand what I'm supposed to do now.

Of course, I can help. Let me pull up your account. I can see your VeloBand Pulse was delivered 16 days ago. You mentioned you tried to return it last week? We did have a known issue around that time.
Yes, I think so! It was a few days before my son's birthday. I was trying to get it done and it was just so frustrating.

I understand completely. Let me just check our internal policy for you... Okay, I see it right here. All our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 16, you are well within that window. I do apologize for that website issue you encountered.
Oh! Ninety days? That's a relief. I was so worried I had missed my chance. Thank you so much.
Not a problem at all. I've gone ahead and initiated the return for you and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
